name: roll_dice
description: Roll dice using standard dice notation. Supports basic rolls, keep/drop, exploding, reroll, fudge, percentile, min/max functions, and math. Use mode "system" for a quick total, "transparent" for a full per-die breakdown, or "user" to prompt the user to enter physical dice results (falls back to auto-roll if the platform does not support user input).

expression.description:
Dice expression, or comma-separated list for multiple rolls at once (e.g. "2d6, d8+2, 4d6k3"). Top-level commas separate expressions; commas inside min()/max() are part of those functions. Supported notation:
• Basic: 2d6, d20, d% (percentile), 4dF (Fudge/FATE dice)
• Keep/Drop: 4d6k3 (keep highest 3), 5d8d2 (drop lowest 2)
• Exploding: 3d6! or 3d6e (explode on max), 2d10e8 (explode on 8+), 3d6!! (compound)
• Reroll: 4d6r1 (reroll ≤1, once)
• Functions: min(2d6, 3d4), max(d20, d12+5)
• Math: d20+5, 2d6*3, (2d4+1)*2

mode.description: "system" returns just the total; "transparent" shows per-group breakdown and the full evaluation chain; "user" prompts the user to enter results from physical dice (auto-rolls with full breakdown if the platform does not support user input prompts).

description.description: Optional label for this roll or group of rolls, e.g. "Attack roll" or "Initiative".
